title: First lines of code
summary: I grew up playing video games and taking things apart to see how they worked. By 10 I was sure I wanted to work with computers, and I started teaching myself HTML and a little C++.
highlights: Built my first web pages in plain HTML.
Wrote my first C++ programs, mostly to understand how the games I played worked.
growth: Where the curiosity that drives the rest of this timeline started.
